name: New York NYSPHSAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: New York NYSPHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: East Aurora's boys, No. 26 in DyeStat's national team rankings, go for a fourth straight Class C title. Shenendehowa's Riley Lynch (No. 15) and Ithaca's Tsadia Bercuvitz (No. 18) are among the top girls in the country. · First race 9:30 a.m. ET
